what: Long-running recovery prose still mandates re-invoking the fenced bash `Invoke:` block without scoping to `LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL=bash`
scenario_or_breakage: After the default flips to Python, a timeout or unexpected turn end on the default path can still route the orchestrator back through `scripts/ship-pr.sh` instead of the selector’s `python/ship.py` + JSON routing — the same failure mode the plan flags for stale delegation, via a different sentence
suggested_fix: Add a bash-only qualifier on the recovery bullet (or point recovery at the selector’s Python re-invocation) so default-path recovery never names the fenced `ship-pr.sh` `Invoke:` block as authoritative
